mapper.select: select exists ( select 1 from pep_platform.app_user where id = #{userId} and state = 'ACTIVE')

select exists ( select 1 from pep_platform.role_binding b join pep_platform.role_permission p on p.role_id = b.role_id where b.principal_type in ('USER', 'GROUP') and b.principal_id = #{userId}::text and p.permission_code = #{permission} and b.scope_type = 'PLATFORM' and b.scope_id = '*')
